activity_summary: Master Thwaite prayed for Cornwall and for Devon, and he prayed forty of the Queen's ships. Mistress Ansell said he had no towns. You would not add one, and you did not say the number you knew.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Prayed the two counties and the number he had been given.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Told him the towns were missing, and closed it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused to improve the prayer, and did not give the number.

facets.activity: Heard Master Thwaite pray forty ships

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: Forty sail, set against the galleys in the west
